correctness.rationale: The strict-successor equivalences use transitivity; outside F each bit is read directly from its closure or interior indicator. F has stable selected/unselected strict witnesses outside F, so all choices of F independently preserve both approximations, and no other bits can vary. Non-T0 equivalent points yield a common fiber of two incomparable singletons that excludes their meet, proving necessity. Conditional Bernoulli independence and the entropy chain rule give the formula. A deterministic standalone program verified all fibers of 6,231 posets (324,180 realized fibers), Bernoulli(1/2) and Bernoulli(1/3) formulas, and all preorders through size four. No experiment is used as proof of the general claim.

None is a stated corollary of the cited image-level conclusions alone.

value.rationale: For the naturally occurring map from finite subsets to lower/upper topological approximations, it is mathematically meaningful to know precisely which original coordinates remain reconstructible. The universal Boolean-interval theorem gives complete inverse-fiber geometry and a sharp T0 criterion, while the exact Shannon entropy law collapses information loss to strict-upper-degree data. These are structural facts for every finite poset, not an arbitrary isolated enumeration or a simple restatement of image-lattice structure.
